import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import os
from datetime import datetime
import math

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load training data with reduced memory footprint
print("Loading training data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(
    "input/labels.csv",
    dtype={
        "pickup_latitude": "float32",
        "pickup_longitude": "float32",
        "dropoff_latitude": "float32",
        "dropoff_longitude": "float32",
        "passenger_count": "int8",
        "fare_amount": "float32",
    },
)

# Load test data
print("Loading test data...")
test_df = pd.read_csv(
    "input/test.csv",
    dtype={
        "pickup_latitude": "float32",
        "pickup_longitude": "float32",
        "dropoff_latitude": "float32",
        "dropoff_longitude": "float32",
        "passenger_count": "int8",
    },
)

# Load sample submission for format reference
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")


# Function to calculate Haversine distance
def haversine_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth radius in kilometers
    phi1 = np.radians(lat1)
    phi2 = np.radians(lat2)
    delta_phi = np.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    delta_lambda = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)

    a = (
        np.sin(delta_phi / 2) ** 2
        + np.cos(phi1) * np.cos(phi2) * np.sin(delta_lambda / 2) ** 2
    )
    c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))

    return R * c


# Function to calculate bearing direction
def calculate_bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    """Calculate the bearing from point 1 to point 2 in degrees (0-360)"""
    phi1 = np.radians(lat1)
    phi2 = np.radians(lat2)
    delta_lambda = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)

    y = np.sin(delta_lambda) * np.cos(phi2)
    x = np.cos(phi1) * np.sin(phi2) - np.sin(phi1) * np.cos(phi2) * np.cos(delta_lambda)

    bearing = np.degrees(np.arctan2(y, x))
    bearing = (bearing + 360) % 360  # Normalize to 0-360

    return bearing


# Function to extract datetime features with cyclical encoding
def extract_datetime_features(df):
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])
    df["year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["day"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["day_of_week"] >= 5).astype(int)
    df["is_night"] = ((df["hour"] >= 22) | (df["hour"] <= 5)).astype(int)
    df["is_peak_hour"] = (
        (df["hour"] >= 7) & (df["hour"] <= 9) | (df["hour"] >= 16) & (df["hour"] <= 19)
    ).astype(int)

    # Cyclical encoding for hour (0-23)
    df["hour_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["hour"] / 24)
    df["hour_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["hour"] / 24)

    # Cyclical encoding for day_of_week (0-6)
    df["day_of_week_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["day_of_week"] / 7)
    df["day_of_week_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["day_of_week"] / 7)

    # Cyclical encoding for month (1-12)
    df["month_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["month"] / 12)
    df["month_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["month"] / 12)

    return df


# Filter outliers - NYC coordinates are approximately:
# Latitude: 40.5 to 40.9
# Longitude: -74.3 to -73.7
print("Filtering outliers...")
valid_train = train_df[
    (train_df["pickup_latitude"] > 40.5)
    & (train_df["pickup_latitude"] < 40.9)
    & (train_df["pickup_longitude"] > -74.3)
    & (train_df["pickup_longitude"] < -73.7)
    & (train_df["dropoff_latitude"] > 40.5)
    & (train_df["dropoff_latitude"] < 40.9)
    & (train_df["dropoff_longitude"] > -74.3)
    & (train_df["dropoff_longitude"] < -73.7)
    & (train_df["fare_amount"] > 0)
    & (train_df["fare_amount"] < 250)
    & (train_df["passenger_count"] > 0)
    & (train_df["passenger_count"] < 7)
].copy()

# Additional outlier filtering based on fare/distance ratio
valid_train["distance_temp"] = haversine_distance(
    valid_train["pickup_latitude"],
    valid_train["pickup_longitude"],
    valid_train["dropoff_latitude"],
    valid_train["dropoff_longitude"],
)
valid_train["fare_per_km"] = valid_train["fare_amount"] / valid_train["distance_temp"]
valid_train = valid_train[
    (valid_train["fare_per_km"] > 0.5) & (valid_train["fare_per_km"] < 50)
].copy()
valid_train = valid_train.drop(columns=["distance_temp", "fare_per_km"])

print(f"Valid training data after filtering: {valid_train.shape[0]} rows")

# Sample if too large for memory
if valid_train.shape[0] > 20000000:
    valid_train = valid_train.sample(n=20000000, random_state=42)
    print(f"Sampled to: {valid_train.shape[0]} rows")

# Extract datetime features
print("Extracting datetime features...")
valid_train = extract_datetime_features(valid_train)
test_df = extract_datetime_features(test_df)

# Calculate Haversine distance
print("Calculating distance features...")
valid_train["distance"] = haversine_distance(
    valid_train["pickup_latitude"],
    valid_train["pickup_longitude"],
    valid_train["dropoff_latitude"],
    valid_train["dropoff_longitude"],
)

test_df["distance"] = haversine_distance(
    test_df["pickup_latitude"],
    test_df["pickup_longitude"],
    test_df["dropoff_latitude"],
    test_df["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Calculate bearing direction
print("Calculating bearing direction...")
valid_train["bearing"] = calculate_bearing(
    valid_train["pickup_latitude"],
    valid_train["pickup_longitude"],
    valid_train["dropoff_latitude"],
    valid_train["dropoff_longitude"],
)

test_df["bearing"] = calculate_bearing(
    test_df["pickup_latitude"],
    test_df["pickup_longitude"],
    test_df["dropoff_latitude"],
    test_df["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Additional distance features
valid_train["lat_diff"] = np.abs(
    valid_train["pickup_latitude"] - valid_train["dropoff_latitude"]
)
valid_train["lon_diff"] = np.abs(
    valid_train["pickup_longitude"] - valid_train["dropoff_longitude"]
)
test_df["lat_diff"] = np.abs(test_df["pickup_latitude"] - test_df["dropoff_latitude"])
test_df["lon_diff"] = np.abs(test_df["pickup_longitude"] - test_df["dropoff_longitude"])

# Passenger count features
valid_train["passenger_count"] = valid_train["passenger_count"].astype("int8")
test_df["passenger_count"] = test_df["passenger_count"].astype("int8")

# Interaction features
valid_train["distance_hour"] = valid_train["distance"] * valid_train["hour"]
valid_train["distance_day_of_week"] = (
    valid_train["distance"] * valid_train["day_of_week"]
)
valid_train["distance_passenger"] = (
    valid_train["distance"] * valid_train["passenger_count"]
)
valid_train["bearing_sin"] = np.sin(np.radians(valid_train["bearing"]))
valid_train["bearing_cos"] = np.cos(np.radians(valid_train["bearing"]))

# New interaction features with cyclical encodings
valid_train["distance_hour_sin"] = valid_train["distance"] * valid_train["hour_sin"]
valid_train["distance_hour_cos"] = valid_train["distance"] * valid_train["hour_cos"]
valid_train["distance_dow_sin"] = (
    valid_train["distance"] * valid_train["day_of_week_sin"]
)
valid_train["distance_dow_cos"] = (
    valid_train["distance"] * valid_train["day_of_week_cos"]
)

test_df["distance_hour"] = test_df["distance"] * test_df["hour"]
test_df["distance_day_of_week"] = test_df["distance"] * test_df["day_of_week"]
test_df["distance_passenger"] = test_df["distance"] * test_df["passenger_count"]
test_df["bearing_sin"] = np.sin(np.radians(test_df["bearing"]))
test_df["bearing_cos"] = np.cos(np.radians(test_df["bearing"]))

# New interaction features with cyclical encodings
test_df["distance_hour_sin"] = test_df["distance"] * test_df["hour_sin"]
test_df["distance_hour_cos"] = test_df["distance"] * test_df["hour_cos"]
test_df["distance_dow_sin"] = test_df["distance"] * test_df["day_of_week_sin"]
test_df["distance_dow_cos"] = test_df["distance"] * test_df["day_of_week_cos"]

# Define feature columns
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "distance",
    "lat_diff",
    "lon_diff",
    "bearing",
    "bearing_sin",
    "bearing_cos",
    "year",
    "month",
    "day",
    "hour",
    "day_of_week",
    "is_weekend",
    "is_night",
    "is_peak_hour",
    "distance_hour",
    "distance_day_of_week",
    "distance_passenger",
    # Cyclical encodings
    "hour_sin",
    "hour_cos",
    "day_of_week_sin",
    "day_of_week_cos",
    "month_sin",
    "month_cos",
    # New interaction features with cyclical encodings
    "distance_hour_sin",
    "distance_hour_cos",
    "distance_dow_sin",
    "distance_dow_cos",
]

# Prepare training data
X = valid_train[feature_cols].values
y = valid_train["fare_amount"].values

# Split into train and validation (10% validation)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train)}, Validation samples: {len(X_val)}")

# Train XGBoost model
print("Training XGBoost model...")
params = {
    "objective": "reg:squarederror",
    "eval_metric": "rmse",
    "max_depth": 6,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "n_estimators": 500,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "min_child_weight": 3,
    "gamma": 0.1,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 1.0,
    "random_state": 42,
    "verbosity": 0,
}

model = xgb.XGBRegressor(**params)
model.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], verbose=False)

# Predict on validation set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)

# Calculate RMSE on validation set
rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, y_val_pred))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")

# Prepare test predictions
print("Generating test predictions...")
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_df["key"], "fare_amount": test_predictions})

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Sample predictions: {submission['fare_amount'].head()}")
